title: Rowan Bell · Community Manager · call with Maren Hedgemore · July 2026
notice: Synthetic demo material. Invented document; no real meeting, publication, email or call occurred.

blocks.text: Call with Maren Hedgemore, buyer for Gillikin Growers Cooperative. Discussing two upcoming projects.

First, Maren confirmed she’s organizing the rental of a shared cold-storage unit. Location is a facility just off the main Brickway spur near Violet Hills. She’s got a draft agreement from the property owner. The idea is for members to drop surplus turnips, carrots, and beets there in the days before the weekly market, so trucks aren’t overloaded on the morning of. She says she’s still working out the access schedule and the per-bushel fee to cover the rental.

Second item: Maren arranged a bulk delivery of potting soil. She coordinated with a Winkie flour mill whose truck was coming back empty after a grain delivery to the Emerald City. They agreed to load fifty bags at the mill’s cost and drop them at the central pickup spot in Violet Hills—the old livery yard. She said the freight saving is about twenty percent versus a dedicated shipment. The soil is due to arrive next week; she’ll notify members when it’s ready for pickup.

Maren sounded pleased with the soil deal. She mentioned the cold-storage talks are trickier because some growers are worried about mixing up their crates. She’s planning to propose a color-coded tag system at the next cooperative meeting.
